tables.label: T10
tables.title: Cells With a Simulated Value and Stories Published, by Configuration (Read-Out of the P5 Run)
tables.note: Read from the records of run_20261008_01 (no new simulation). A cell has a simulated salience value when at least 8 weeks hold at least 5 simulated stories, a framing value when at least 5 published items carry a coder frame, and a timing value when at least 3 published core or event items carry a first-core-mention lag; wire items carry no lag. The standardized errors in Table T4 are means over the cells that hold a value, so the timing error of a dependence configuration rests on the cells listed here. Means over the 20 seeds of the planned order (dependence, imitation, herding).

tables.label: T11
tables.title: Effective Daily Cap on Own Stories Under the Fitted Dependence Rule, by Outlet
columns: Cap B at the fitted w = 1.00 (Ukraine / Gaza / COP)
Cap B at w = 0 (Ukraine / Gaza / COP)
Keeps no own story at the fitted w
tables.note: B = round(n × (1 − W) × (w × C + 1 − w)), with n the outlet's mean daily count of issue stories in the fitting half. At the fitted w = 1.00 the cap is n × (1 − W) × C, so an outlet with no staff foreign byline (C = 0.00) keeps no own proposal and publishes wire copy only. 17 of 18 outlets keep no own story at the fitted w. Correspondent presence (V9) is exploratory (X12); the plan fixed it as the rule's C before the data.
